build_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: build a python module that converts a batch of quaternions to 3x3 rotation matrices using quaternion_to_rotation_matrix
build_quaternion_to_wigner_d_l2: build a python module that computes l=2 Wigner D matrices from quaternions using quaternion_to_wigner_d_l2_einsum
build_quaternion_to_wigner_d_l3l4: build a python module that computes l=3 and l=4 Wigner D matrices from quaternions using quaternion_to_wigner_d_l3l4_batched
build_custom_kernel_module: build a pytorch nn.Module that loads precomputed Wigner D coefficient tensors as buffers via CustomKernelModule
generate_monomials: generate all monomials of a given degree in n variables using the _generate_monomials function
